description: This file defines the DbStoredQueries class which manages stored SQL queries for Orleans' ADO.NET storage providers. It includes query templates for clustering, reminders, streaming, and grain directory functionalities, along with methods for parsing query results into Orleans data structures.

classes.name: DbStoredQueries
classes.description: Manages SQL query templates and result parsing for Orleans storage providers.
